title: MPPSC Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: 949 Assistant Professor posts across multiple subjects and phases under the MPPSC Assistant Professor recruitment cycle.
qualification: As per subject-wise MPPSC Assistant Professor recruitment notification.
ageLimit: As per MPPSC recruitment notification and applicable Madhya Pradesh government rules.
applicationFee: General / Other State: ₹500; MP reserved category candidates: ₹250, plus applicable portal charges.
selectionProcess: Written/OMR Examination → Interview / Document Verification as applicable → Final Selection
documentsRequired: Registration/Enrollment Number or Date of Birth for downloading the admit card; printed admit card and valid original photo ID for the examination.
howToApply:
1. Visit https://mppsc.mp.gov.in
2. Open the Admit Card section
3. Select the relevant Assistant Professor examination
4. Login using the required registration/enrollment details and date of birth
5. Download and print the admit card
6. Verify examination date, centre, shift and reporting instructions
shortDescription: MPPSC Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 has been released for the relevant examination phases. Candidates can download the hall ticket from mppsc.mp.gov.in.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has released the Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 for the relevant subject-wise examination phases.

The MPPSC Assistant Professor recruitment is being conducted in multiple phases. The official examination schedule includes examinations on 12 July 2026, 2 August 2026 and 30 August 2026.

Candidates should download their admit card only through the official MPPSC website and carefully verify their name, roll number, examination centre, date, shift and reporting time before appearing for the examination.
